### Key Takeaway
All six CRMs cluster tightly in the **4.0–4.7 star range** on both platforms, with **Capsule and Copper scoring highest on G2** (4.5–4.7), while **HubSpot and Pipedrive edge slightly higher on Capterra** (4.5). **Insightly consistently ranks lowest** of the group (around 4.0–4.2 on both platforms).
